**1. E33G Remote Worker visa requires USD 60K/year income.**
*   **Status:** CONFIRMED.
*   **Legal Basis:** National regulation *Permenkumham 11/2024 Pasal 63 Ayat (2)* explicitly mandates proof of salary or income of at least USD 60,000 per year from a foreign source for the E33G visa [1, 2].

**2. E33G holders cannot work for Indonesian clients.**
*   **Status:** CONFIRMED.
*   **Legal Basis:** Under national law *Permenkumham 11/2024 Pasal 33 Ayat (2) Huruf j Angka 5*, the E33G remote worker must be tied to an employment relationship with a company located outside Indonesian territory [3, 4]. It is strictly prohibited to work for Indonesian companies or generate income from local Indonesian clients [2, 5]. At the local level in Bali, the Tim Pora (Foreigner Surveillance Team) actively monitors for digital nomads violating this rule, treating local client engagement on a non-working visa as a primary red flag [6].

**3. Golden Visa has 3 tiers: Tier 1 USD 2.5M/10yr, Tier 2 USD 350K/5yr, Tier 3 USD 130K/5yr.**
*   **Status:** WRONG. 
*   **Correction & Legal Basis:** 
    *   **Tier 1 (10-year E28B with company):** The minimum investment required is **USD 5,000,000**, not USD 2.5M, pursuant to *Permenkumham 11/2024 Pasal 40 Ayat (2)* [7, 8]. The USD 2.5M threshold applies exclusively to the 5-year E28B variant (*Permenkumham 11/2024 Pasal 39 Ayat 2*) [7, 9].
    *   **Tier 2 (5-year E28C Individual/Portfolio):** This claim is correct. It requires a minimum investment of USD 350,000 in government bonds, public shares, or mutual funds (*Permenkumham 11/2024 Pasal 39 Ayat 3*) [10].
    *   **Tier 3 (USD 130K/5yr):** This threshold actually belongs to the **E33B Second Home Visa** via bank deposit (*Permenkumham 11/2024 Pasal 56 Ayat 2*), which is classified differently from the core E28 Golden Visa series [11-13]. 

**4. KITAS Investor E28A is 2 years renewable.**
*   **Status:** CONFIRMED.
*   **Legal Basis:** *Permenkumham 11/2024 Pasal 33 Ayat (2) Huruf e Angka 1* defines the standard foreign investor stay limit as a maximum of 2 years per issuance [14, 15]. This permit is legally renewable [16].

**5. B211A max 180 days, no work.**
*   **Status:** CONFIRMED (with terminology update).
*   **Legal Basis:** The old B211A index has been formally reclassified as the **C1 Visit Visa** for tourism under the new index system of *Permenkumham 22/2023* [17, 18]. National law strictly limits the maximum cumulative stay to 180 days (an initial 60 days plus extensions) and absolutely prohibits any work or business activities (*Permenkumham 11/2024 Pasal 95 Ayat 3*) [17-19]. Furthermore, under a recent local enforcement directive in Bali (March 31, 2026), C1 extensions are now automatically rejected if the foreigner is registered as a shareholder or director in an Indonesian PT PMA [20].

Il visto C1 ha sostituito il precedente codice B211A nel quadro di questo riassetto normativo [IMM-370]. Si tratta di un visto a singolo ingresso destinato al turismo, con una durata iniziale di 60 giorni prorogabile fino a un massimo di 180 giorni totali [IMM-370]. Le domande presentate prima dell'entrata in vigore della nuova regolamentazione rimangono valide [IMM-354]. Gli adesivi visto acquisiti secondo la regolamentazione precedente (ovvero i vecchi visti B211A) rimangono in uso fino al loro esaurimento [IMM-355]. I visti emessi prima dell'entrata in vigore della nuova normativa restano validi fino alla loro naturale scadenza [IMM-356].
